evidence.reason: systemd defines `%i` as the escaped instance name and `%I` as the unescaped instance name; the implementation substitutes the same escaped text for both. For an escaped instance like `ingress@crq\x2dtick.socket`, `Service=%I.service` names `crq-tick.service`, but this code produces `crq\x2dtick.service`, so the dependency scan misses the CRQ reference the function exists to surface (per its own docstring, expansion is what makes the CRQ name visible). This is a correctness defect in existing intended behavior, not a new requirement: the contract has no relevant clause overriding systemd's specifier semantics, and the fix is minimal (unescape `%I` only, leave `%i` escaped).
